items.article_summary: Scott Melker discusses two Thai businessmen suing Tether over the freezing of $42.4 million in USDT ( USDT-USD ) and alleged it occurred more than three months before a seizure warrant was issued. " The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker " airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Lawsuit challenges Tether for allegedly freezing 42.4 million USDT before US warrant. So, this is two Thai businessmen suing Tether over the freezing of their 40 plus million dollars in USDT that they held across 10 Ethereum addresses.
